research_question: Can an autonomous inter-burst idle detector match explicit pause-boundary bounded retention without pause callbacks on Apple M2 Pro (16 KiB pages), while avoiding false triggers during continuous streams and short 80 ms jitter?
hypothesis: IdleReclamationController (idle_threshold_ms=250) with a screened resident free-page budget will fire 0 times during continuous runs and 80 ms jitter, reduce idle physical footprint by >=45% vs BFC during >=1 s idle pauses, keep continuous FPS >=0.97x BFC, and keep burst/mixed median p99 <=1.05x BFC with max_abs_error == 0.
acceptance_gates: max_abs_error == 0; idle_private_bytes <= 0.50 * BFC; continuous_fps >= 0.97 * BFC; burst_p99 <= 1.05 * BFC
